purpose: Dated price comparisons and explicit assumptions for the five-cent departure food estimate; not a recovered Independence tariff.

guardian_march.limits: Two years after setting and a different departure market. Published quotations, not evidence that every buyer obtained unlimited quantities.

guardian_may.limits: Shortage comparison after setting. The paper attributes high prices to demand, cold weather and animal feed scarcity; not a permanent universal price multiplier.

merchants_1848.section: printed p438, PDF page87, visually verified
merchants_1848.observation: Values flour at $4.25/barrel for an estimated annual produce-receipts total.
merchants_1848.limits: Valuation for aggregate trade, not a departure-store retail quote. Do not treat package prices as per-pound quotes or trust misaligned OCR sums.

palmer.limits: One guide's advice and reported prices, not a representative survey. Existing source hash is in ECONOMY_PRESERVATION_SOURCES.json.

marcy.section: chapter I provisions; chapter V jerking meat
marcy.limits: Later expedition advice; not an 1848 family diet, validated recipe, or source of exact game probabilities.

fao_composition.section: Annex I, food composition per100g as purchased
fao_composition.limits: Modern broad food groups in as-purchased weights; not field-recovered species-specific edible yields or a complete nutritional model.

basket_limits: A deliberately partial 310-lb comparison using four weighed foods from the earlier guide, not a complete outfit. Omits pilot bread, beans, fruit, coffee, tea, salt and other goods. The blend is not the exact recipe of every in-game food unit.

decision.basis: An authored nominal-dollar mixed-provision estimate above the March partial basket and below the later shortage comparison. Broader provisions, preparation and local merchant variation justify a provisional allowance; no exact historical markup is claimed.
decision.funds: Retain $600/$900/$1400 asset-sale/difficulty scenarios with wagon, gun and basic gear owned. Historical household wealth has not established exact profession-specific starting cash. Do not increase funds to cancel costs.
decision.unchanged: Rations, yields, spoilage, travel, wages, resupply offers, event odds and cargo quantities are unchanged in this pass.
